camera: Standing eye height across both traffic lanes, offset toward the stall’s cab end and looking obliquely at its serving side; wide shot, 35mm lens feel. The road runs across the foreground.
background: Low shopfronts with blank signboards stand behind the far curb. The maroon cab occupies frame left, with the open hatch near centre; the bus-stop pole and broad dark-green tree remain frame right beyond the vehicle’s rear.
picture: A slightly soft tuk-tuk occupies the lower foreground in side profile, pointed screen right, its windows obscuring the occupants without blocking the hatch. Across the road, the compact maroon stall stands beneath its raised hatch, with the scratched serving ledge and small trays visible. The red mannequin stands small at centre behind the ledge, chest angled outward toward the road in the right foreground and head turned in the same direction. Its right hand holds the flask upright and low beside its waist, its left hand rests near the pastry tray, and the customer space to its right is empty.
